speaker: RUFUS
text: Yes. Meta shares rose after the launch of its Muse AI agent, Reuters reported on September ninth. The launch itself happened September eighth. speaker: JAMIE
text: Because the choice to integrate or not integrate is increasingly not really a choice — your competitors are integrating. But what today adds is a framework for evaluating that decision. speaker: ALEX
text: I hear you. I'm not abandoning the position yet. Internal dissent followed by public resignation can be the system working — the pressure valve releasing before a catastrophic failure. But I'll concede this: it only counts as self-correcting if something actually corrects. And we don't know yet whether it will.

speaker: JAMIE
